item.title: Suriel Figurine with Teacup for an ACOTAR Bookshelf
item.description: A little Suriel with a teacup attached, sitting on the shelf beside the books it came from. It's a decorative figure made to sit among your ACOTAR collection, or on a desk or in a display cabinet. We make each one to order here in Canada, printed in PLA plastic in our small shop. It also makes an easy gift for the friend who lent you the series in the first place.
